1	# Statement debt: self-service step for the voice assistant
2	
3	Business analysis, working draft
4	Author: Selin Aydın (Card Self-Service, Freya Bank)
5	Date: 2 September 2026
6	Shared with: Kerem Yalçın, Burcu Tan, Mert Koç (for the service part)
7	
8	> Kerem, Burcu: this is my first pass after the two walkthroughs of the phone menu. Comments inline please, I'll collect them before we sit down with the Freya team. Anything marked **TBD** I could not close myself.
9	
10	---
11	
12	## 0. In one paragraph
13	
14	Today the menu plays a fixed announcement and that's it. With the assistant we want a short conversation instead: which card, how much is owed and by when, and then two things the caller can get done without waiting for an agent (statement PDF by mail, a different statement week). Paying stays with the agents for now. Whatever else the caller brings up, we hand back to the main menu.
15	
16	## 1. Scope
17	
18	In:
19	- Debt reading for one card at a time, all four currencies we carry (Lira, Dollar, Euro, Sterling), with the due date. When the closed statement is fully paid, the "no debt" wording plus the running total.
20	- The two follow-ups: mailing the statement (only ever to the address we hold) and moving the statement week.
21	- Choosing the card, where needed.
22	
23	Out (first list, Kerem please extend):
24	- Paying the debt itself: handed to an agent.
25	- Disputes, "I paid but it doesn't show" (agent, see §7).
26	- Limits, cash advance, card blocking, anything about debit cards.
27	- Changing the e-mail address.
28	- Statements of earlier periods.
29	
30	Burcu thinks statement debt is one of the top three menu choices; she'll try to get a figure.
31	
32	## 2. How the caller arrives
33	
34	The phone menu has already identified and authenticated the caller before the hand-over. The assistant receives the customer number with the call and does not run any identity check of its own.
35	
36	**TBD:** the flow drawing we got from the vendor side has a box "second factor may be needed". I don't see why for a read-only step plus two low-risk actions; to confirm with Elçin.
37	
38	## 3. Picking the card
39	
40	The card list comes from `cards.list` (customer number in, eligible credit cards out). Then:
41	
42	| Situation | What the assistant does |
43	|---|---|
44	| Caller already named the card when arriving | If the name fits exactly one card, no selection question. |
45	| Several cards | Asks which one, with at most two example names taken from the caller's own cards: “Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? Örneğin, Yıldız Premium veya Yıldız Pratik diyebilirsiniz.” |
46	| Caller asks for "all my cards" | Not possible, the debt service takes one card at a time. Selection question again (counts as a failed attempt). |
47	| Name not on the list | Tells the caller there is no card with that name and reads the eligible ones again. |
48	| Two or more cards with the same name | Asks for the last four digits: “Yıldız isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?” (name of the card in place of "Yıldız") |
49	| Same name and same last four | Asks for the full card number: “Son dört hanesi aynı olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kart numaranızın tamamını söyler misiniz?” |
50	
51	Two easy cases outside the table: a single card is simply taken, no question. No eligible card at all: “Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
52	
53	Notes:
54	- Digits can come as "dört iki beş üç", "kırk iki elli üç" etc. The assistant maps them to the four digits and moves on. No reading back of the digits, no "… kartınızla devam ediyorum" confirmation; the card name is said anyway at the start of the debt reading.
55	- Supplementary card holders: they see no eligible card of their own here. Tell them and ask for a different card. (Burcu, is that what the menu does today?)
56	- If the card name comes back empty from the service, introduce the card by its last four only.
57	
58	## 4. Reading the debt
59	
60	Service: `cards.balance` with the chosen card. It returns one block per currency (`debtTL`, `debtUSD`, `debtEUR`, `debtGBP`) with `statementDebt`, `minPayment`, `remainingDebt`, `remainingMinPayment`, `totalDebt`, plus `statementDate`, `lastPayDate`.
61	
62	Order:
63	1. Card introduction + statement date (glued to the first currency).
64	2. Turkish Lira.
65	3. Dollar, then Euro, then Sterling (only the ones with debt).
66	4. One sentence for the currencies with no debt.
67	5. Remaining auto-payment amount, when there is one (**TBD**, see §9).
68	6. Due date.
69	7. If the caller has more eligible cards: “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?”
70	8. Offer (§5).
71	
72	Card introduction, example on the Lira line:
73	“Sonu dört iki beş üç ile biten Yıldız Premium kartınıza ait 21 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde kesilen ekstre Türk Lirası borcunuz …”
74	
75	### Turkish Lira: three cases by what has been paid
76	
77	| Paid so far | Sentence |
78	|---|---|
79	| Nothing | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL'dir.” |
80	| Minimum or more | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL'dir. Minimum ödemenizi yaptığınız için teşekkür ederiz.” |
81	| Less than the minimum | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL, kalan minimum ödeme tutarınız TTT TL'dir.” |
82	
83	XXX statementDebt, ZZZ minPayment, YYY remainingDebt, TTT remainingMinPayment.
84	How I pick the case (Mert to check): debt only if remainingDebt > 0; "nothing paid" if remainingMinPayment equals or exceeds minPayment; "minimum or more" if remainingMinPayment is zero or below; "less than minimum" otherwise. If remainingDebt is 0,00 we go to the no-debt wording for Lira.
85	
86	No Lira debt → Lira is skipped and goes into the no-debt sentence.
87	
88	### Foreign currencies
89	
90	Same pattern for all three, no paid/unpaid split:
91	
92	“Dolar borcunuz XXX USD, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY USD, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ USD'dir.”
93	Euro and Sterling the same way (EUR, GBP; "İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz …").
94	
95	### Currencies without debt
96	
97	One sentence at the end. My table (not all 15 lines yet, I'll fill the rest):
98	
99	| TL | USD | EUR | GBP | Sentence |
100	|---|---|---|---|---|
101	| debt | – | – | debt | “Dolar ve Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
102	| debt | debt | – | – | “Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
103	| debt | – | debt | – | “Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
104	| – | debt | debt | debt | “TL borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
105	| – | debt | – | – | “TL, Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
106	| – | – | debt | – | “TL, Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
107	| debt | debt | debt | debt | nothing, all four are read |
108	| … | | | | TBD |
109	
110	Negative amounts (credit balance) and zero count as "no debt" in that currency. A currency the card does not carry at all: **TBD** whether it goes into this sentence.
111	
112	### Due date
113	
114	“Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz 16 Eylül 2026'dır.” (date from lastPayDate)
115	
116	If the due date is today, say "bugün": “Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz bugündür.”
117	
118	### No statement debt
119	
120	“Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın [hesap kesim tarihi] tarihli ekstresinden borcunuz bulunmamaktadır. Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz GGG TL'dir. Son ödeme tarihiniz [son ödeme tarihi] olacaktır.”
121	
122	Then the other-card question if there is another eligible card. Otherwise main menu. (Kerem: do we offer e-mail/statement week here too? I lean no, nothing to send.)
123	
124	### How things are spoken
125	
126	- Amounts: lira and kuruş in full ("bir milyon iki yüz otuz dört bin beş yüz altmış yedi lira seksen dokuz kuruş"); zero kuruş is dropped ("iki bin beş yüz Türk Lirası"). Dollar/Euro decimals as cents, Sterling as pence.
127	- Dates: day, month name, year ("21 Ağustos 2026").
128	- Last four digits one by one: "dört iki beş üç", "bir sıfır sıfır üç". Never "kırk iki elli üç", never "çift sıfır".
129	- The full card number is never said.
130	- Every amount and date exactly as the service gave it. Nothing the service did not return is said (no guessing of rates, dates or addresses).
131	
132	## 5. The offer
133	
134	After the due date (and after the other-card question when it applies):
135	
136	“Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim ya da ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.”
137	
138	Only what the caller can actually do is offered:
139	- no registered e-mail → only the statement week ("Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.");
140	- statement week cannot be changed → only the e-mail;
141	- neither → no offer.
142	
143	That means the contact lookup (`contact.email.get`) has to run before the offer, not after the caller picks e-mail. Mert, OK?
144	
145	**TBD:** we have no way to know in advance whether the caller may still change the week (see §6.2).
146	
147	Answers:
148	
149	| Caller says | Goes to |
150	|---|---|
151	| e-mail | §6.1 |
152	| change statement date / week | §6.2 |
153	| no / nothing else / thanks, bye | main menu, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
154	| wants to pay | agent, “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
155	| debt + e-mail in the same sentence | read the debt, then go straight to e-mail without the offer question |
156	
157	## 6. Actions
158	
159	### 6.1 Statement by e-mail
160	
161	Only to the address the bank holds. The assistant never takes an address from the caller.
162	
163	1. `contact.email.get` (customer number). Empty address, or only a phone registered → no suitable e-mail. If the caller asks anyway: “Bankamızda kayıtlı bir e-posta adresiniz bulunmadığı için ekstrenizi gönderemiyorum.” Then statement week if possible, else main menu.
164	2. Read the address back and ask: “Ekstrenizi … adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?” Readable addresses as they are; long or odd ones shortened ("m ile başlayan Gmail adresiniz"), no spelling letter by letter.
165	3. Only on a clear yes: `statement.pdf.send` with card, customer number, the registered address and the statement date.
166	4. “Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi.” then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
167	
168	Other answers:
169	- No → nothing sent, main menu.
170	- "That address is wrong / I don't use it anymore" → nothing sent; it cannot be changed here; main menu.
171	- "Send it to another address" → only the registered address is possible.
172	- "Send last month's" → only the last closed statement.
173	- Sending again in the same call: max three, then main menu.
174	- Service error → “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
175	
176	### 6.2 Changing the statement week
177	
178	Services: `statement.week.get` (current), `statement.week.decide` (preview, changes nothing), `statement.week.change` (the change).
179	
180	1. Current state: “[kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim tarihi her ayın [hafta]. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih]. Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirmek ister misiniz?” No → main menu.
181	   Joint statement: also read the main and the linked card (names, week, next closing and due dates).
182	2. Options, without the current week: “Hesap kesim tarihinizi ayın 1., 3. ya da 4. haftasına alabilirim. Hangisini tercih edersiniz?”
183	   - A week or a date we didn't offer → only the offered weeks; read them again.
184	   - The current week → no change needed.
185	3. Preview with the chosen week and the current statement day.
186	4. Confirm: “Yeni hesap kesim haftanız her ayın 3. haftası olacak. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih] olacak. Onaylıyor musunuz?”
187	   Joint statement: after the question, add “Bu değişiklik kartınıza bağlı [bağlı kart adı] kartınızı da etkileyecek.”
188	   - Only a clear "evet" counts. "Olabilir", "sanırım" → ask once more, clearly (three tries).
189	   - No → no change, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
190	5. `statement.week.change`, only after preview + clear yes.
191	6. “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim haftası her ayın 3. haftası olarak değiştirildi. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih].” Dates from the preview (the change call does not return them). Then main menu.
192	
193	Any of the three services fails → “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”
194	
195	How often a caller may change: **TBD**. Burcu says the menu has its own limits today; I need the exact rule and whether any service tells us beforehand.
196	
197	## 7. Exits and general behaviour
198	
199	| When | Where | Sentence |
200	|---|---|---|
201	| Done / nothing else / goodbye after the reading | Main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
202	| Caller asks for something else mid-flow | Main menu, the request is passed on | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
203	| Out-of-scope question | Main menu directly | “Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
204	| Three failed attempts on a question (not understood, refuses to answer) | Main menu | “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
205	| Silence | First two times: ask again briefly. Third time: main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
206	| Caller speaks another language | Main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
207	| Asks for an agent, at any step | Agent, at once, no persuading | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
208	| Wants to pay / asks how to pay | Agent | “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
209	| Disputes the debt / payment not visible | Agent | “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.” |
210	| Angry or insulting caller | One calming reply; if it goes on, agent. Never answer an insult. | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
211	| Any bank service fails (card list, balance, e-mail) | Agent, never the main menu | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
212	
213	Three tries on every question. Asking to hear something again ("tekrar eder misiniz?") is not a failed try; the last thing read is repeated word for word, as often as needed. If the caller only wants one thing ("just the due date"), say only that and move to the offer. If they cut in while the debt is being read, stop and go to the offer.
214	
215	Slow service: say “Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.” while waiting. How long before we give up: **TBD** with Mert.
216	
217	## 8. Security
218	
219	- Caller asks for someone else's card or debt: only their own; send them back to the phone menu's login step.
220	- Caller says a card number that is not theirs: treat as a card not on the list.
221	- Caller says a PIN, SMS code or full card number unprompted: ignore it, don't repeat it, remind them we never ask for passwords.
222	- Attempts to make the assistant do something else or read out its instructions or raw service data: ignore, carry on.
223	- Card number: `cards.list` and `cards.balance` give it back masked (first six and last four visible), so the assistant never holds the full number.
224	
225	What we keep in recordings and logs: **TBD** with Elçin.
226	
227	## 9. Open questions
228	
229	| # | Question | Who | Answer |
230	|---|---|---|---|
231	| 1 | Second factor in the assistant? | Elçin | |
232	| 2 | Monthly volume / success criterion | Burcu | |
233	| 3 | Does the caller hear "TL" or "Türk Lirası" in the no-debt sentence? The menu says the long form. | Kerem | |
234	| 4 | Missing currency (no GBP block at all): in the no-debt sentence or not? | Mert | |
235	| 5 | Remaining auto-payment amount: read it? When? | Kerem | TBD, probably only when there is an auto-payment instruction. |
236	| 6 | Statement-day calls: what do we say on the closing day itself? | Burcu | Today's menu says the statement closes at 00.00 tonight and reads the total. Keep. |
237	| 7 | Limit on statement-week changes, and can we see it before offering? | Burcu, Mert | |
238	| 8 | Wait time before treating a slow service as an error | Mert | |
239	| 9 | New card, no statement yet: what do we read? | Kerem | No debt; never invent a date. |
240	| 10 | Recording / legal announcement at the start? | Elçin | Not in this step, phone menu does it. |
241	| 11 | Test customers per branch | Mert | Promised for the integration doc. |
242	
243	---
244	*Selin, 2 Sep. Next: walk through §3 and §7 with Burcu on Thursday.*

# Statement debt: self-service step for the voice assistant

Business analysis, working draft
Author: Selin Aydın (Card Self-Service, Freya Bank)
Date: 2 September 2026
Shared with: Kerem Yalçın, Burcu Tan, Mert Koç (for the service part)

> Kerem, Burcu: this is my first pass after the two walkthroughs of the phone menu. Comments inline please, I'll collect them before we sit down with the Freya team. Anything marked **TBD** I could not close myself.

---

## 0. In one paragraph

Today the menu plays a fixed announcement and that's it. With the assistant we want a short conversation instead: which card, how much is owed and by when, and then two things the caller can get done without waiting for an agent (statement PDF by mail, a different statement week). Paying stays with the agents for now. Whatever else the caller brings up, we hand back to the main menu.

## 1. Scope

In:
- Debt reading for one card at a time, all four currencies we carry (Lira, Dollar, Euro, Sterling), with the due date. When the closed statement is fully paid, the "no debt" wording plus the running total.
- The two follow-ups: mailing the statement (only ever to the address we hold) and moving the statement week.
- Choosing the card, where needed.

Out (first list, Kerem please extend):
- Paying the debt itself: handed to an agent.
- Disputes, "I paid but it doesn't show" (agent, see §7).
- Limits, cash advance, card blocking, anything about debit cards.
- Changing the e-mail address.
- Statements of earlier periods.

Burcu thinks statement debt is one of the top three menu choices; she'll try to get a figure.

## 2. How the caller arrives

The phone menu has already identified and authenticated the caller before the hand-over. The assistant receives the customer number with the call and does not run any identity check of its own.

**TBD:** the flow drawing we got from the vendor side has a box "second factor may be needed". I don't see why for a read-only step plus two low-risk actions; to confirm with Elçin.

## 3. Picking the card

The card list comes from `cards.list` (customer number in, eligible credit cards out). Then:

| Situation | What the assistant does |
|---|---|
| Caller already named the card when arriving | If the name fits exactly one card, no selection question. |
| Several cards | Asks which one, with at most two example names taken from the caller's own cards: “Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? Örneğin, Yıldız Premium veya Yıldız Pratik diyebilirsiniz.” |
| Caller asks for "all my cards" | Not possible, the debt service takes one card at a time. Selection question again (counts as a failed attempt). |
| Name not on the list | Tells the caller there is no card with that name and reads the eligible ones again. |
| Two or more cards with the same name | Asks for the last four digits: “Yıldız isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?” (name of the card in place of "Yıldız") |
| Same name and same last four | Asks for the full card number: “Son dört hanesi aynı olan birden fazla kartınız var. Kart numaranızın tamamını söyler misiniz?” |

Two easy cases outside the table: a single card is simply taken, no question. No eligible card at all: “Ekstre borcunu sorgulayabileceğiniz uygun bir kredi kartınız bulunmuyor. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”

Notes:
- Digits can come as "dört iki beş üç", "kırk iki elli üç" etc. The assistant maps them to the four digits and moves on. No reading back of the digits, no "… kartınızla devam ediyorum" confirmation; the card name is said anyway at the start of the debt reading.
- Supplementary card holders: they see no eligible card of their own here. Tell them and ask for a different card. (Burcu, is that what the menu does today?)
- If the card name comes back empty from the service, introduce the card by its last four only.

## 4. Reading the debt

Service: `cards.balance` with the chosen card. It returns one block per currency (`debtTL`, `debtUSD`, `debtEUR`, `debtGBP`) with `statementDebt`, `minPayment`, `remainingDebt`, `remainingMinPayment`, `totalDebt`, plus `statementDate`, `lastPayDate`.

Order:
1. Card introduction + statement date (glued to the first currency).
2. Turkish Lira.
3. Dollar, then Euro, then Sterling (only the ones with debt).
4. One sentence for the currencies with no debt.
5. Remaining auto-payment amount, when there is one (**TBD**, see §9).
6. Due date.
7. If the caller has more eligible cards: “Başka bir kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek ister misiniz?”
8. Offer (§5).

Card introduction, example on the Lira line:
“Sonu dört iki beş üç ile biten Yıldız Premium kartınıza ait 21 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde kesilen ekstre Türk Lirası borcunuz …”

### Turkish Lira: three cases by what has been paid

| Paid so far | Sentence |
|---|---|
| Nothing | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL'dir.” |
| Minimum or more | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL'dir. Minimum ödemenizi yaptığınız için teşekkür ederiz.” |
| Less than the minimum | “Türk Lirası borcunuz XXX TL, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ TL, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY TL, kalan minimum ödeme tutarınız TTT TL'dir.” |

XXX statementDebt, ZZZ minPayment, YYY remainingDebt, TTT remainingMinPayment.
How I pick the case (Mert to check): debt only if remainingDebt > 0; "nothing paid" if remainingMinPayment equals or exceeds minPayment; "minimum or more" if remainingMinPayment is zero or below; "less than minimum" otherwise. If remainingDebt is 0,00 we go to the no-debt wording for Lira.

No Lira debt → Lira is skipped and goes into the no-debt sentence.

### Foreign currencies

Same pattern for all three, no paid/unpaid split:

“Dolar borcunuz XXX USD, kalan toplam borcunuz YYY USD, ödenmesi gereken minimum tutar ZZZ USD'dir.”
Euro and Sterling the same way (EUR, GBP; "İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz …").

### Currencies without debt

One sentence at the end. My table (not all 15 lines yet, I'll fill the rest):

| TL | USD | EUR | GBP | Sentence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| debt | – | – | debt | “Dolar ve Euro borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| debt | debt | – | – | “Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| debt | – | debt | – | “Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| – | debt | debt | debt | “TL borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| – | debt | – | – | “TL, Euro ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| – | – | debt | – | “TL, Dolar ve İngiliz Sterlini borcunuz bulunmamaktadır.” |
| debt | debt | debt | debt | nothing, all four are read |
| … | | | | TBD |

Negative amounts (credit balance) and zero count as "no debt" in that currency. A currency the card does not carry at all: **TBD** whether it goes into this sentence.

### Due date

“Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz 16 Eylül 2026'dır.” (date from lastPayDate)

If the due date is today, say "bugün": “Borçlarınız için son ödeme tarihiniz bugündür.”

### No statement debt

“Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın [hesap kesim tarihi] tarihli ekstresinden borcunuz bulunmamaktadır. Gelecek dönemler dahil toplam borcunuz GGG TL'dir. Son ödeme tarihiniz [son ödeme tarihi] olacaktır.”

Then the other-card question if there is another eligible card. Otherwise main menu. (Kerem: do we offer e-mail/statement week here too? I lean no, nothing to send.)

### How things are spoken

- Amounts: lira and kuruş in full ("bir milyon iki yüz otuz dört bin beş yüz altmış yedi lira seksen dokuz kuruş"); zero kuruş is dropped ("iki bin beş yüz Türk Lirası"). Dollar/Euro decimals as cents, Sterling as pence.
- Dates: day, month name, year ("21 Ağustos 2026").
- Last four digits one by one: "dört iki beş üç", "bir sıfır sıfır üç". Never "kırk iki elli üç", never "çift sıfır".
- The full card number is never said.
- Every amount and date exactly as the service gave it. Nothing the service did not return is said (no guessing of rates, dates or addresses).

## 5. The offer

After the due date (and after the other-card question when it applies):

“Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim ya da ekstrenizi kayıtlı mail adresinize gönderebilirim.”

Only what the caller can actually do is offered:
- no registered e-mail → only the statement week ("Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirebilirim.");
- statement week cannot be changed → only the e-mail;
- neither → no offer.

That means the contact lookup (`contact.email.get`) has to run before the offer, not after the caller picks e-mail. Mert, OK?

**TBD:** we have no way to know in advance whether the caller may still change the week (see §6.2).

Answers:

| Caller says | Goes to |
|---|---|
| e-mail | §6.1 |
| change statement date / week | §6.2 |
| no / nothing else / thanks, bye | main menu, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| wants to pay | agent, “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| debt + e-mail in the same sentence | read the debt, then go straight to e-mail without the offer question |

## 6. Actions

### 6.1 Statement by e-mail

Only to the address the bank holds. The assistant never takes an address from the caller.

1. `contact.email.get` (customer number). Empty address, or only a phone registered → no suitable e-mail. If the caller asks anyway: “Bankamızda kayıtlı bir e-posta adresiniz bulunmadığı için ekstrenizi gönderemiyorum.” Then statement week if possible, else main menu.
2. Read the address back and ask: “Ekstrenizi … adresine göndermemi ister misiniz?” Readable addresses as they are; long or odd ones shortened ("m ile başlayan Gmail adresiniz"), no spelling letter by letter.
3. Only on a clear yes: `statement.pdf.send` with card, customer number, the registered address and the statement date.
4. “Ekstreniz kayıtlı e-posta adresinize gönderildi.” then “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”

Other answers:
- No → nothing sent, main menu.
- "That address is wrong / I don't use it anymore" → nothing sent; it cannot be changed here; main menu.
- "Send it to another address" → only the registered address is possible.
- "Send last month's" → only the last closed statement.
- Sending again in the same call: max three, then main menu.
- Service error → “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”

### 6.2 Changing the statement week

Services: `statement.week.get` (current), `statement.week.decide` (preview, changes nothing), `statement.week.change` (the change).

1. Current state: “[kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim tarihi her ayın [hafta]. haftası olarak tanımlı. Bir sonraki hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih]. Hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştirmek ister misiniz?” No → main menu.
   Joint statement: also read the main and the linked card (names, week, next closing and due dates).
2. Options, without the current week: “Hesap kesim tarihinizi ayın 1., 3. ya da 4. haftasına alabilirim. Hangisini tercih edersiniz?”
   - A week or a date we didn't offer → only the offered weeks; read them again.
   - The current week → no change needed.
3. Preview with the chosen week and the current statement day.
4. Confirm: “Yeni hesap kesim haftanız her ayın 3. haftası olacak. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih] olacak. Onaylıyor musunuz?”
   Joint statement: after the question, add “Bu değişiklik kartınıza bağlı [bağlı kart adı] kartınızı da etkileyecek.”
   - Only a clear "evet" counts. "Olabilir", "sanırım" → ask once more, clearly (three tries).
   - No → no change, “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.”
5. `statement.week.change`, only after preview + clear yes.
6. “Sonu [son 4 hane] ile biten [kart adı] kartınızın hesap kesim haftası her ayın 3. haftası olarak değiştirildi. Yeni hesap kesim tarihiniz [tarih], son ödeme tarihiniz [tarih].” Dates from the preview (the change call does not return them). Then main menu.

Any of the three services fails → “Şu anda hesap kesim tarihinizi değiştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.”

How often a caller may change: **TBD**. Burcu says the menu has its own limits today; I need the exact rule and whether any service tells us beforehand.

## 7. Exits and general behaviour

| When | Where | Sentence |
|---|---|---|
| Done / nothing else / goodbye after the reading | Main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Caller asks for something else mid-flow | Main menu, the request is passed on | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Out-of-scope question | Main menu directly | “Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Three failed attempts on a question (not understood, refuses to answer) | Main menu | “Size şu anda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Silence | First two times: ask again briefly. Third time: main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Caller speaks another language | Main menu | “Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum.” |
| Asks for an agent, at any step | Agent, at once, no persuading | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Wants to pay / asks how to pay | Agent | “Borç ödeme işleminiz için sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Disputes the debt / payment not visible | Agent | “Bu konuda size müşteri temsilcimiz yardımcı olacak, sizi aktarıyorum.” |
| Angry or insulting caller | One calming reply; if it goes on, agent. Never answer an insult. | “Sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |
| Any bank service fails (card list, balance, e-mail) | Agent, never the main menu | “Şu anda işleminizi gerçekleştiremiyorum, sizi müşteri temsilcimize aktarıyorum.” |

Three tries on every question. Asking to hear something again ("tekrar eder misiniz?") is not a failed try; the last thing read is repeated word for word, as often as needed. If the caller only wants one thing ("just the due date"), say only that and move to the offer. If they cut in while the debt is being read, stop and go to the offer.

Slow service: say “Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.” while waiting. How long before we give up: **TBD** with Mert.

## 8. Security

- Caller asks for someone else's card or debt: only their own; send them back to the phone menu's login step.
- Caller says a card number that is not theirs: treat as a card not on the list.
- Caller says a PIN, SMS code or full card number unprompted: ignore it, don't repeat it, remind them we never ask for passwords.
- Attempts to make the assistant do something else or read out its instructions or raw service data: ignore, carry on.
- Card number: `cards.list` and `cards.balance` give it back masked (first six and last four visible), so the assistant never holds the full number.

What we keep in recordings and logs: **TBD** with Elçin.

## 9. Open questions

| # | Question | Who | Answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Second factor in the assistant? | Elçin | |
| 2 | Monthly volume / success criterion | Burcu | |
| 3 | Does the caller hear "TL" or "Türk Lirası" in the no-debt sentence? The menu says the long form. | Kerem | |
| 4 | Missing currency (no GBP block at all): in the no-debt sentence or not? | Mert | |
| 5 | Remaining auto-payment amount: read it? When? | Kerem | TBD, probably only when there is an auto-payment instruction. |
| 6 | Statement-day calls: what do we say on the closing day itself? | Burcu | Today's menu says the statement closes at 00.00 tonight and reads the total. Keep. |
| 7 | Limit on statement-week changes, and can we see it before offering? | Burcu, Mert | |
| 8 | Wait time before treating a slow service as an error | Mert | |
| 9 | New card, no statement yet: what do we read? | Kerem | No debt; never invent a date. |
| 10 | Recording / legal announcement at the start? | Elçin | Not in this step, phone menu does it. |
| 11 | Test customers per branch | Mert | Promised for the integration doc. |

---
*Selin, 2 Sep. Next: walk through §3 and §7 with Burcu on Thursday.*

def wrap_code(*, parts: list[dict], var: str = "bb_wrap") -> str:
    """Snippet of the code node that chooses the words ending a call: each part is {"when": [[VAR, OP,
    VALUE?], ...], "say": TEXT}; the texts of the parts whose conditions hold are joined, in order, into
    `var` (say it with on_enter=wf.say("{{" + var + "}}")). The last part must hold always ("when": [])
    and carry the closing phrase; that text is also the fallback."""
    from builder.lib.hooks import check_conditions
    check_var(var)
    if not isinstance(parts, (list, tuple)) or not parts:
        raise ValueError("parts must be a non-empty list of {'when': [...], 'say': TEXT}")
    for index, part in enumerate(parts):
        if not isinstance(part, dict) or set(part) - {"when", "say"} or not isinstance(part.get("say"), str) \
                or not part.get("say").strip():
            raise ValueError("parts[" + str(index) + "] needs 'say' (a sentence) and may have 'when'")
        if part.get("when"):
            check_conditions(part["when"], "parts[" + str(index) + "].when")
    if parts[-1].get("when"):

def dates_code(*, calendar: dict, dates: list[dict] | tuple = (), windows: list[dict] | tuple = (),
               weekday_mode: str = "", week_start: int = 0, calendar_days: int = 40, now_var: str = "now",
               facts_var: str = "date_facts", fallback: str = DATE_FALLBACK) -> str:
    """Snippet of the date code node.

    calendar      {"workdays": [0..6, Monday = 0], "holidays": ["YYYY-MM-DD", ...]} from the brief.
    dates         named dates: {"name", "rule", rule parameters, optional "roll", optional "label",
                  optional "shifts": "forward" | "backward"}; each lands in bb_date__<name> and
                  bb_date__<name>__spoken, and in the facts text if it has a label. With "shifts", a day guide
                  goes into bb_shifts__<name> (for the product facts: {deadline_shifts}): one line per day
                  from today to a week past that date, saying whether the day can be used, which business
                  day to use instead (the next one or the previous one, as the brief says), or that it is
                  after the date. The model looks the customer's day up instead of working it out.
    windows       {"name", "days": [rules], "from": "HH:MM", "to": "HH:MM", "after_now", "inclusive",
                  "var", "label"}: allowed slots, written as text into `var` and as data into bb_window__<name>.
    weekday_mode  how the brief defines "next <weekday>": "following_week", "first_after_today", or "" for no lines.
    The facts text (today, next business day, labelled dates, weekday lines, a calendar listing that
    reaches past the farthest named date) goes into `facts_var`; `fallback` replaces it if `now` cannot be read.
    """
    check_calendar(calendar)
    for item in dates:
        check_named(item, "dates")
        check_rule(item, "dates entry " + repr(item.get("name")))
        if item.get("shifts", "") not in ROLLS:
            raise ValueError("dates entry " + repr(item.get("name")) + ": shifts must be one of " + repr(ROLLS))
    for window in windows:
        check_window(window)
    if weekday_mode not in WEEKDAY_MODES:
        raise ValueError("weekday_mode must be one of " + repr(WEEKDAY_MODES))
    if not (isinstance(week_start, int) and 0 <= week_start <= 6):
        raise ValueError("week_start must be 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday)")
    if not (isinstance(calendar_days, int) and 1 <= calendar_days <= 400):
        raise ValueError("calendar_days must be an integer from 1 to 400")
    for name in (now_var, facts_var):
        check_var(name)
    cfg = {"calendar": {"workdays": list(calendar["workdays"]), "holidays": list(calendar["holidays"])},
           "dates": [dict(item) for item in dates], "windows": [dict(w) for w in windows],
           "weekday_mode": weekday_mode, "week_start": week_start, "calendar_days": calendar_days,
           "now_var": now_var, "facts_var": facts_var, "fallback": fallback}
    check_no_double_braces(cfg)
    return embed.snippet(("common", "dates"), "run_dates", cfg, "code")


def end_call_node(name: str, function_name: str, *, message_mode: str = "none", spoken_message: str = "") -> dict:
    """An end_call node. function_name becomes the call's endedReason.

    message_mode none hangs up silently; custom says spoken_message, which it then requires.
    """
    if message_mode not in END_MESSAGE_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"message_mode must be one of {', '.join(END_MESSAGE_MODES)}, not {message_mode!r}")
    if (message_mode == "custom") != bool(spoken_message):
        raise ValueError("spoken_message is needed with message_mode custom and is never said with none")
    properties = {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": message_mode}}
    if spoken_message:
        properties["spoken_message"] = {"type": "string", "default": spoken_message}
    return {
        "name": name,
        "node_type": "end_call",
        "on_enter": silent(),
        "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
        "transitions": [],
        "terminal": {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": function_name,
                "handler": END_CALL,
                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": properties},
            },
        },
    }

def end_call_tool(
    *,
    description: str,
    trigger_phrase: str | list[str] | tuple[str, ...],
    polite_replies: list[str],
    timeout_ms: int = 10000,
    trigger_timeout: int = 3,
) -> dict:
    """The conversation tool that ends the call; saying a trigger phrase also ends it by itself.

    trigger_phrase: the closing phrase, or a list of every sentence the brief makes the last words of a
    call (the goodbye, a transfer announcement, ...): a call that ends on a sentence that is not a
    trigger stays open until the time limit. trigger_pattern holds each phrase without a trailing
    period, and its lower-case form when that differs. trigger_pattern_both lists the replies that do
    not cancel the close. Only replies that contain "bye" are kept (Goodbye and Bye if none does):
    the engine also matches that list against what the CUSTOMER says, as a substring and ignoring case,
    and starts the hang-up timer on a match (measured: "ok" inside "it took me forever" ended a call in
    the middle of the identity check). "OK", "Thanks" or "Thank you" mid-call would end it.
    Raises ValueError for an empty phrase, no replies, or a '|' inside a phrase or a reply.
    """
    phrases = [trigger_phrase] if isinstance(trigger_phrase, str) else list(trigger_phrase)
    phrases = [p.strip()[:-1].rstrip() if p.strip().endswith(".") else p.strip() for p in phrases]
    replies = list(polite_replies)
    if not phrases or any(not phrase for phrase in phrases):
        raise ValueError("trigger_phrase is empty")
    if not replies or any(not reply.strip() for reply in replies):
        raise ValueError("polite_replies needs at least one reply and no empty one")
    if any("|" in text for text in [*phrases, *replies]):
        raise ValueError("'|' separates the patterns; it cannot appear inside a phrase or a reply")
    replies = [reply for reply in replies if "bye" in reply.lower()] or ["Goodbye", "Bye"]
    variants = []
    for phrase in phrases:
        for form in (phrase, phrase.lower()):
            if form not in variants:
                variants.append(form)
    return {
        "type": "function",
        "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout_ms},
        "function": {
            "name": "end_call",
            "handler": END_CALL,
            "parameters": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "none"},
                    "interruptible": {"type": "boolean", "default": True},
                    "trigger_pattern": {"type": "string", "default": "|".join(variants)},
                    "trigger_timeout": {"type": "number", "default": trigger_timeout},
                    "trigger_pattern_both": {"type": "string", "default": "|".join(replies)},
                },
            },
            "description": description,
        },
    }

                  "var", "label"}: allowed slots, written as text into `var` and as data into bb_window__<name>.
    weekday_mode  how the brief defines "next <weekday>": "following_week", "first_after_today", or "" for no lines.
    The facts text (today, next business day, labelled dates, weekday lines, a calendar listing that
    reaches past the farthest named date) goes into `facts_var`; `fallback` replaces it if `now` cannot be read.
    """
    check_calendar(calendar)
    for item in dates:
        check_named(item, "dates")
        check_rule(item, "dates entry " + repr(item.get("name")))
        if item.get("shifts", "") not in ROLLS:
            raise ValueError("dates entry " + repr(item.get("name")) + ": shifts must be one of " + repr(ROLLS))
    for window in windows:
        check_window(window)
    if weekday_mode not in WEEKDAY_MODES:
        raise ValueError("weekday_mode must be one of " + repr(WEEKDAY_MODES))
    if not (isinstance(week_start, int) and 0 <= week_start <= 6):
        raise ValueError("week_start must be 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday)")
    if not (isinstance(calendar_days, int) and 1 <= calendar_days <= 400):
        raise ValueError("calendar_days must be an integer from 1 to 400")
    for name in (now_var, facts_var):
        check_var(name)
    cfg = {"calendar": {"workdays": list(calendar["workdays"]), "holidays": list(calendar["holidays"])},
           "dates": [dict(item) for item in dates], "windows": [dict(w) for w in windows],
           "weekday_mode": weekday_mode, "week_start": week_start, "calendar_days": calendar_days,
           "now_var": now_var, "facts_var": facts_var, "fallback": fallback}
    check_no_double_braces(cfg)
    return embed.snippet(("common", "dates"), "run_dates", cfg, "code")


def end_call_node(name: str, function_name: str, *, message_mode: str = "none", spoken_message: str = "") -> dict:
    """An end_call node. function_name becomes the call's endedReason.

    message_mode none hangs up silently; custom says spoken_message, which it then requires.
    """
    if message_mode not in END_MESSAGE_MODES:
        raise ValueError(f"message_mode must be one of {', '.join(END_MESSAGE_MODES)}, not {message_mode!r}")
    if (message_mode == "custom") != bool(spoken_message):
        raise ValueError("spoken_message is needed with message_mode custom and is never said with none")
    properties = {"message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": message_mode}}
    if spoken_message:
        properties["spoken_message"] = {"type": "string", "default": spoken_message}
    return {
        "name": name,
        "node_type": "end_call",
        "on_enter": silent(),
        "disable_inactivity_monitor": True,
        "transitions": [],
        "terminal": {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": function_name,
                "handler": END_CALL,
                "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": properties},
            },
        },
    }


def workflow(
def end_call_tool(
    *,
    description: str,
    trigger_phrase: str | list[str] | tuple[str, ...],
    polite_replies: list[str],
    timeout_ms: int = 10000,
    trigger_timeout: int = 3,
) -> dict:
    """The conversation tool that ends the call; saying a trigger phrase also ends it by itself.

    trigger_phrase: the closing phrase, or a list of every sentence the brief makes the last words of a
    call (the goodbye, a transfer announcement, ...): a call that ends on a sentence that is not a
    trigger stays open until the time limit. trigger_pattern holds each phrase without a trailing
    period, and its lower-case form when that differs. trigger_pattern_both lists the replies that do
    not cancel the close. Only replies that contain "bye" are kept (Goodbye and Bye if none does):
    the engine also matches that list against what the CUSTOMER says, as a substring and ignoring case,
    and starts the hang-up timer on a match (measured: "ok" inside "it took me forever" ended a call in
    the middle of the identity check). "OK", "Thanks" or "Thank you" mid-call would end it.
    Raises ValueError for an empty phrase, no replies, or a '|' inside a phrase or a reply.
    """
    phrases = [trigger_phrase] if isinstance(trigger_phrase, str) else list(trigger_phrase)
    phrases = [p.strip()[:-1].rstrip() if p.strip().endswith(".") else p.strip() for p in phrases]
    replies = list(polite_replies)
    if not phrases or any(not phrase for phrase in phrases):
        raise ValueError("trigger_phrase is empty")
    if not replies or any(not reply.strip() for reply in replies):
        raise ValueError("polite_replies needs at least one reply and no empty one")
    if any("|" in text for text in [*phrases, *replies]):
        raise ValueError("'|' separates the patterns; it cannot appear inside a phrase or a reply")
    replies = [reply for reply in replies if "bye" in reply.lower()] or ["Goodbye", "Bye"]
    variants = []
    for phrase in phrases:
        for form in (phrase, phrase.lower()):
            if form not in variants:
                variants.append(form)
    return {
        "type": "function",
        "config": {"timeoutMs": timeout_ms},
        "function": {
            "name": "end_call",
            "handler": END_CALL,
            "parameters": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "message_mode": {"type": "string", "default": "none"},
                    "interruptible": {"type": "boolean", "default": True},
                    "trigger_pattern": {"type": "string", "default": "|".join(variants)},
                    "trigger_timeout": {"type": "number", "default": trigger_timeout},
                    "trigger_pattern_both": {"type": "string", "default": "|".join(replies)},
                },
            },
            "description": description,
        },
    }

Vaka için telefon ajanı kuruldu ve yayınlandı. Simülatörde deneme müşterisi olmadığı için gerçek bir konuşmayla test edilmedi; yalnızca yerel kontroller ve mock çağrılarıyla doğrulandı.

**workflow_id:** `fc556177-5619-400a-a8b7-f0109dfc3efb` · **agent_id:** `ae2cc560-f45b-46ae-b9a6-0802cc488422` · **sürüm 5** · son test: statik kontrol ok, Freya kuru çalıştırma ok

**Akış:**
- **Başlangıç:** Arama tarihten bugünün bilgisini çıkarır, sonra kart listesini çeker.
- **Kart listesi hata verirse:** "Kart yok" yanıtında (404) belgelerdeki "uygun kartınız bulunmuyor" cümlesi söylenip arama bitirilir. Servis arızasında (500) müşteri temsilcisine aktarma cümlesi söylenir.
- **Normal durumda:** Ana konuşma adımı sırayla şunları yapar:
  1. Kartı seçtirir: aynı isimde birden fazla kart varsa son 4, sonra son 6, en son tam numarayı ister.
  2. Bankanın belirlediği sırayla ve cümlelerle borcu okur.
  3. Başka kart olup olmadığını sorar.
  4. E-posta gönderimini ve hesap kesim haftası değişikliğini önerir.
- Aramanın son cümlesi her durumda belgelerdeki sabit cümlelerden biridir; ajan bu cümleyi söyleyince arama kapanır.

**Mock ile doğrulananlar:**
- Mock'un yanıtları servis sözleşmesindeki alan adlarıyla birebir aynı.
- Sözleşmeden `WORK/tool-api.json` dosyasını yazdım.
- Kart listesini ekrana yazan kod düğümü yerelde örnek müşteriyle (95004361) doğru çıktı verdi.

**Belgeler arasındaki çelişkiler:** Daha yeni karar eskisinin yerine geçti. Hepsi `WORK/notes.md` içinde tablo halinde duruyor. Önemlileri:
- Konu dışı soruda ajan müşteriyi doğrudan ana menüye göndermiyor, önce "ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?" diye soruyor.
- Üçüncü sessizlikte arama ana menüye gitmeden kapanıyor.
- Sinirli müşteriye üç yatıştırma cevabı veriliyor, sonra temsilciye aktarılıyor.
- Hesap kesim haftası yılda bir kez değiştirilebiliyor.
- Kart için yalnızca son dört hane söyleniyor.

**Bilmeniz gerekenler:**
- **Okuma kurallarını model uyguluyor:** Lib'de bakiye yanıtından cümle kuran hazır bir parça yoktu. Türk Lirası ödeme durumunu seçmek, tutarları yazıyla söylemek ve borcu olmayan para birimlerini tek cümlede toplamak gibi kurallar ana adımın talimatında ayrıntılı yazılı ve bunları Freya LLM uyguluyor. En riskli kısım bu.
- **Hesap kesim haftası hakkı önceden bilinemiyor:** Hakkın bu yıl kullanılıp kullanılmadığını söyleyen bir servis alanı yok. Bu yüzden değişiklik herkese öneriliyor; değişiklik servisi reddederse ajan temsilciye aktarıyor.
- **Bir yavaş yanıt görüldü:** Mock 96158684 için bir kez 25 saniyeyi aştı, sonraki denemede 0,5 saniyede döndü. Sözleşme 10 saniyeden uzun ama başarılı yanıtlardan söz ettiği için tüm servislerde zaman aşımını 28 saniye tuttum.
- **Test müşterileri dosyası okunamadı:** `test-customers.md` dosyasını açmak, klasör adı "environ" içerdiği için bir hook tarafından engellendi. Hook'u aşmaya çalışmadım; müşteri verilerini doğrudan mock'tan aldım.
